IT BEGINS! First two pages are a cohesive spread, so you get both!

I also included unobstructed images of Rail's basic floorplan (neither Fletcher nor I are architects, so take the layouts with a grain of salt. It's just meant to give readers a general idea of the interior!), and, of course, a more zoomed in shot of Fletcher's phone 😉

Alright, wish me luck you animals, for the main comic is officially off hiatus and back at it! Thanks for being here and continuing to support, and I'm really excited to continue with you all 🥂🪩💕

Hooray! I'm still working on the back cover and character sheets in the bonus section, but those will be coming up soon :3

I think what makes the most sense is to place character sheets inside the volumes where characters get NSFW scenes in the book. So this volume will only have sheets for Coop, Andy, River, and Mark. Waldren, Noah, and the rest of the crew will be getting theirs during their featured roles in future volumes! It's not to say I won't work on them til then, they just won't be physically inside the books yet~

Have a nice weekend everyone! Stay hydrated and such ☀️
